tldr: Black Moon Lilith in the 7th house.
body: You refuse to disappear inside a partnership; relationship is where the disowned self gets triggered and reclaimed. Idealized expectations projected onto partners, with disappointment when they prove human. Attracts independent, rebellious partners, and relationship crises tend to be the catalyst for real healing.
business: Demands an equal who does not try to own you.
shadow: Power struggles, or attracting the controlling dynamic you fear.
policy: Modern point; secondary weighting only. Not used in dignity, sect, or time-lord logic, and never treated as a primary chart ruler. Weight up only when it aspects a personal planet or angle, or sits on an angle.
